subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: The UNESCO was given in the form of a resolution unanimously The proclamation is a great tribute and glowing homage to the language proclaimed martyrs It came in Bangladesh The recognition was tabled to spread mother tongue widely The resolution February 21st as the International Mother Language Day in 1999
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (a) The UNESCO proclaimed February 21st as the International Mother Language Day in 1999. (b) The proclamation came in the form of a resolution unanimously. (c) It is a great tribute and glowing homage to the language martyrs. (d) The recognition was given to spread mother tongue widely. (e) The resolution was tabled in Bangladesh.
